title: Smithers
body:
A flow lives beside the repository at `.smithers/flows/<name>/`. Durable runs retain their plan, approvals and events.

- [Project state](wiki:project-state)
- [Landing queue](wiki:landing-queue)
author: smithers-agent

title: Project state
body:
`smthrs doctor` checks project discovery without launching a run. Sources live in `.smithers/flows/`; control and execution databases live in `.flows/control.db` and `.flows/engine.db`.

Source: [Project and state](smithers.sh/smithers-canary/smithers/blob/main/packages/smithers/docs/concepts/project-and-state.md).
author: smithers-agent

title: Landing queue
body:
The Stack is the landing queue. You land; the queue runs your submitted tests and mandatory gates first. A failed lint check refuses the landing. maya decides human approvals.

Source: [.smithers/flows/land/flow.ts](smithers.sh/smithers-canary/smithers/blob/main/.smithers/flows/land/flow.ts).
author: maya
